decisions.reason: After two years without visible market presence, this resin injection unit would likely be judged below aspiration and its resources redirected to stronger core offerings or newer development work.

Because it overlaps with another resin injection unit and was likewise not observed afterward, management would be inclined to stop it and concentrate support on the better-performing parts of the injection portfolio.

The automatic airless spray gun still fits the core business, but prolonged non-observation suggests results have not clearly met aspiration levels, making withdrawal slightly more likely than continued support.

A manual airless spray gun is very close to the firm’s established capabilities and customer demand, so management would still allow some slack and keep it unless clearer evidence of persistent underperformance appears.
As a multi-model product line in a central spray category, it offers adaptation potential and strategic relevance that make continued retention more likely despite uncertain visibility.

The data logger is less central than the firm’s main equipment lines, and with no later market visibility management would likely conclude it falls short of aspiration and reallocate effort elsewhere.
